gloss: rhinitis; inflammation of the nasal mucosa

definitions.gloss: rhinitis — inflammation of the mucous membrane of the nose, causing sneezing, a runny nose, or congestion; includes allergic rhinitis and hay fever
definitions.explanation: A medical term used for inflammation of the nose, whether caused by allergy, infection, or other irritation. The most common compound encountered by learners is アレルギー{性|せい}{鼻炎|びえん} (allergic rhinitis), which overlaps heavily with {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever).

examples.japanese: {鼻炎|びえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鼻炎|びえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: I've been suffering from chronic rhinitis.

examples.japanese: ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鼻炎|びえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: I have allergic rhinitis, so every spring is rough for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鼻炎|びえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed me with rhinitis and prescribed some medication.

notes:
A medical term composed of ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧ ("nose") + {炎|えん} ("inflammation"). Covers any inflammation of the nasal mucosa, whether allergic, viral, or chronic.

USAGE:
- Commonly modified by type: ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{鼻炎|びえん} (allergic rhinitis), ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{鼻炎|びえん} (chronic rhinitis), ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{鼻炎|びえん} (acute rhinitis).
- Takes the verbs なる ("to develop"), ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ ("to be severe"), or ⟦{悩|なや}まされる→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧ ("to be troubled by").
- In everyday speech, many people simply say ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つまる or ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧ rather than using {鼻炎|びえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{鼻炎|びえん}: allergic rhinitis
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{鼻炎|びえん}: chronic rhinitis
- {鼻炎|びえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine for rhinitis
- {鼻炎|びえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: symptoms of rhinitis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧: hay fever — a specific type of allergic rhinitis caused by pollen; much more common in everyday speech.
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧: a cold — often causes temporary rhinitis-like symptoms but refers to the illness as a whole.
- ⟦{鼻詰|はなづ}まり→鼻詰まり：16227_hanazumari⟧: nasal congestion — describes the symptom, not the medical condition.
